verdict.rationale: Bevy is distributed as an official first-party Rust crate ("just a normal Rust dependency"), confirmed on crates.io at 0.19.1 with heavy download volume. It has in-depth reference documentation with inline examples, crawlable docs.rs API docs, and many official examples, so agents can build against it with a plain cargo workflow. missing for 10: a stable post-1.0 API (breaking changes every release, a real caveat for agents trained on older APIs), SDKs for languages beyond Rust, and fuller narrative docs (community reports thin docs beyond examples).
